result.text:
Introduction
I first had this as a simple five-step roadmap: Somatic Experiencing, Shaking Qigong / TRE, Brainspotting, EMDR if needed, and then some light CBT. It was too neat. The problem showed up as soon as I started fitting the actual uses into it.
Gentle shaking can be the thing that helps you stay present; a longer shaking practice can be used for discharge. Brainspotting can be resource-oriented or it can go straight into very charged developmental material. Present-focused self-hypnosis can fit early even when deep memory work would be a terrible idea. And somebody with one discrete traumatic memory may be ready for EMDR long before somebody whose trauma is mostly diffuse and developmental.
So I still like the rough movement behind the old roadmap, but I don't think the modalities themselves belong permanently to phases. What matters more is what job you are trying to do, how intense the dose is, what you are aiming at, and whether you can handle what it might open.
That is where the five jobs below came from. Can you stay present and keep choice? Is activation piling up between sessions? Is the trauma showing up as body sensation, emotion, impulse, images, or fragments before there is a clear story? Is there one memory or trigger you can point to? Or has the body calmed enough that the main work now is making sense of what changed and living differently? You can need several of these at once.
The first question matters because trauma healing is not only revisiting memories. The body was involved in surviving whatever happened, and it can keep bracing, collapsing, freezing, disconnecting, scanning for danger, or flooding long after the danger is over. Going deeper is not automatically useful because the session felt dramatic. I want to know whether you can stay there, stop when you need to, and come back to ordinary life afterward.
Inner-child reparenting runs through the map too. Sometimes somatic work makes the body easier to inhabit before you approach the younger part. Sometimes basic reparenting has to come first so there is actually a Nurturer or Protector available when deeper work opens something.
